summary: Landed real, sorry-free progress on Phase 9's GAP 1 (fuel entanglement): a genuine termination bound for applyPersistenceFixpoint's own recursion (applyPersistenceFixpoint_genuine_of_count_le_fuel + 2 supporting lemmas, Scheme.lean, commit a0a16c4b). GAP 2 (determinacy) confirmed BLOCKED by a sharper finding: the persistent T(->) rule is .pos-only, so Sub(phi0) bivalence at every world is not derivable from the existing rule set -- it needs a new tableau branching rule, a calculus-level change out of Phase 10's completeness-side scope. Four inventory sorries unchanged; scoped builds green.

blockers.description: Determinacy (Sub(phi0) bivalence at every reachable world) is not a byproduct of the existing tableau rule set (Rules.lean's 5 decomposition rules + 1 world-creating rule): the persistent T(->) rule is .pos-only and never plants F-tags across worlds. Closing this needs a NEW tableau branching rule (Lindenbaum-style 'decide undecided Sub(phi0) member' step) added to Rules.lean/Expansion.lean, then a soundness re-audit (task 316 territory) -- a calculus redesign, not a Scheme.lean-internal fix. Recommend spinning off a new research+plan task for this before further /implement dispatch on Phase 9/10.

decisions_made: Placed the new gap-1 lemmas after intExpMeasure_init_le_fuel (end of file) rather than near the STOP-gate prose, since their dependencies (intUniverse, applyAllTImpRules_subset, intCount_notMem_append_drop/_mono) are defined later in the file and Lean requires forward declaration.
Did not add a sat_timp field (even in the weak, fixpoint-provable form) since it would sit unused until GAP 2 has a resolution -- avoids unused scaffolding masquerading as progress.
dead_ends: Do not attempt to discharge GAP 2 via sorry, a vacuous statement, or by weakening truthLemma's T-imp case -- it requires new tableau infrastructure, not a proof trick.
